description: Individual directional views (up/down) on assets, with provider, date, horizon, rationale and a link to the source publication. Up/down tallies cover every match; items come in pages (offset / next_offset), spread across providers by default. For the overall picture, call summarize_views first.

limit.description: Items per page, at most 100. Default 100.

offset.description: Skip this many items; pass the previous response's next_offset to read the next page.

order.description: "spread" (default) interleaves providers so each page covers as many sources as possible; "newest" is strictly newest first.

provider_id.description: Limit to one research provider (id from list_providers).

search_rationale.description: Also match terms in the rationale text (for themes like "tariffs" that are not asset names). Default false.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ago. The free plan reaches back 7 days for individual items.

terms.description: Subject words to match (assets, tickers, countries, central banks, companies, themes). Whole-word, case-insensitive; any term may match. Include synonyms and tickers, e.g. ["gold", "xau", "bullion"]. Omit to get everything in range. Matched against the asset name.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: search_asset_views
title: Search asset views
